zg361_mechanism_001_ai_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = just
				has_trait = honest
				has_trait = diligent
				has_trait = compassionate
			}
		}
		zg361_mechanism_001_choice_a_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = arbitrary
				has_trait = callous
				has_trait = deceitful
				has_trait = ambitious
			}
		}
		zg361_mechanism_001_choice_b_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_org_budget_pressure
			var:zg361_org_budget_pressure >= 25
		}
		zg361_mechanism_001_choice_c_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		zg361_mechanism_001_choice_a_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_mechanism_361_ai_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = just
				has_trait = honest
				has_trait = diligent
				has_trait = compassionate
			}
		}
		zg361_mechanism_361_choice_a_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = arbitrary
				has_trait = callous
				has_trait = deceitful
				has_trait = ambitious
			}
		}
		zg361_mechanism_361_choice_b_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_org_budget_pressure
			var:zg361_org_budget_pressure >= 25
		}
		zg361_mechanism_361_choice_c_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		zg361_mechanism_361_choice_a_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_refresh_org_climate_effect = {
	remove_character_modifier = zg361_org_high_trust
	remove_character_modifier = zg361_org_admin_overload
	remove_character_modifier = zg361_org_burnout_crisis
	remove_character_modifier = zg361_org_delivery_stable
	remove_character_modifier = zg361_org_tech_debt_crisis
	remove_character_modifier = zg361_org_talent_healthy
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_org_trust >= 20 }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = zg361_org_high_trust years = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_org_admin_load >= 35 }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = zg361_org_admin_overload years = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_org_burnout >= 20 }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = zg361_org_burnout_crisis years = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_org_stability >= 20 }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = zg361_org_delivery_stable years = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_org_tech_debt >= 20 }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = zg361_org_tech_debt_crisis years = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_org_talent >= 20 }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = zg361_org_talent_healthy years = 1 }
	}
}
